system_info.name: System Info
system_info.command: uname -a; echo '---'; cat /etc/os-release 2>/dev/null | head -8; echo '---'; uptime; echo '---'; nproc 2>/dev/null || grep -c ^processor /proc/cpuinfo; echo '---'; free -h 2>/dev/null | head -2 || cat /proc/meminfo 2>/dev/null | head -3; echo '---'; df -h --output=target,size,used,avail,pcent -x tmpfs -x devtmpfs 2>/dev/null | head -20 || df -h 2>/dev/null | grep -v tmpfs | head -20

services.name: Services
services.command:
if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1 && systemctl is-system-running 2>/dev/null | grep -qE 'running|degraded'; then u=$(systemctl list-unit-files --type=service --no-legend 2>/dev/null | awk '$2!="masked"{print $1}' | grep -v '@' | head -300); [ -n "$u" ] && systemctl show $u --property=Id,ActiveState,SubState,ExecStart --no-pager 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^ExecStart=.*path=\([^ ;]*\).*/ExecStart=\1/'; systemctl list-units --type=service --state=active --no-pager --no-legend 2>/dev/null | head -200 | awk '{printf "Id=%s
ActiveState=active
SubState=%s

", $1, $4}'; elif command -v rc-service >/dev/null 2>&1; then rc-status -a 2>/dev/null | awk '/\[/ {st=($0 ~ /started/)?"active":"inactive"; sub=($0 ~ /started/)?"running":"dead"; printf "Id=%s.service
ActiveState=%s
SubState=%s

", $1, st, sub}' | head -1200; else for f in /etc/init.d/*; do [ -x "$f" ] || continue; n=$(basename $f); if "$f" status >/dev/null 2>&1; then st=active; sub=running; else st=inactive; sub=dead; fi; printf 'Id=%s.service
ActiveState=%s
SubState=%s

' "$n" "$st" "$sub"; done | head -1200; fi

local_units.name: Locally-added Unit Files
local_units.command: for f in /etc/systemd/system/*.service; do t=$(readlink -f "$f" 2>/dev/null); case "$t" in /usr/lib/systemd/*) ;; *) basename "$f";; esac; done 2>/dev/null | head -40

listening_ports.name: Listening Ports
listening_ports.command: if command -v ss >/dev/null 2>&1; then ss -tln 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>1 {print $4}' | head -120; elif command -v netstat >/dev/null 2>&1; then netstat -tln 2>/dev/null | awk 'NR>2 {print $4}' | head -120; fi

installed_packages.name: Installed Packages
installed_packages.command: if command -v rpm >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'PKG_MANAGER: rpm'; rpm -qa --queryformat '%{NAME} %{VERSION}\n' | sort | head -600; elif command -v dpkg >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'PKG_MANAGER: dpkg'; dpkg-query -W -f='${Package} ${Version}\n' | sort | head -600; elif command -v apk >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'PKG_MANAGER: apk'; apk list --installed 2>/dev/null | sed 's/-[0-9].*//' | sort | head -600; elif command -v pacman >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'PKG_MANAGER: pacman'; pacman -Q 2>/dev/null | head -600; else echo 'UNKNOWN'; fi

containers.name: Docker/Podman Containers
containers.command: if command -v docker >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'RUNTIME: docker'; docker ps -a --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Image}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}' 2>/dev/null | head -30; elif command -v podman >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'RUNTIME: podman'; podman ps -a --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Image}}\t{{.Status}}\t{{.Ports}}' 2>/dev/null | head -30; else echo 'NOT_INSTALLED'; fi

cron_jobs.name: Cron Jobs
cron_jobs.command: echo 'SYSTEM:'; cat /etc/crontab 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^#' | grep -v '^$'; echo '---'; echo 'CRON.D:'; ls /etc/cron.d/ 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; echo 'USER CRONTABS:'; for user in $(awk -F: '{print $1}' /etc/passwd); do jobs=$(crontab -l -u $user 2>/dev/null | grep -v '^#' | grep -v '^$'); [ -n "$jobs" ] && echo "[$user]" && echo "$jobs"; done

network_interfaces.name: Network Interfaces
network_interfaces.command: if command -v ip >/dev/null 2>&1; then ip -o addr show | awk '{print $2, $3, $4}' | head -20; else ifconfig 2>/dev/null | head -30; fi

mounted_filesystems.name: Mounted Filesystems
mounted_filesystems.command: mount | grep -v -e tmpfs -e proc -e sysfs -e devpts -e cgroup -e debugfs -e securityfs -e pstore -e fusectl -e configfs -e binfmt | head -20

hardware_info.name: Hardware Info
hardware_info.command: echo 'CPU:'; lscpu 2>/dev/null | grep -e 'Model name' -e 'Socket' -e 'Core' -e 'Thread' -e 'CPU MHz' | head -5 || head -5 /proc/cpuinfo 2>/dev/null; echo '---'; echo 'MEMORY:'; cat /proc/meminfo 2>/dev/null | head -3; echo '---'; echo 'DISKS:'; lsblk -d -o NAME,SIZE,TYPE,MODEL 2>/dev/null | head -10 || cat /proc/partitions 2>/dev/null | head -10

web_servers.name: Web Servers
web_servers.command: if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1 && systemctl is-system-running 2>/dev/null | grep -qE 'running|degraded'; then _svc() { systemctl is-active "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; }; elif command -v rc-service >/dev/null 2>&1; then _svc() { rc-service "$1" status >/dev/null 2>&1; }; else _svc() { [ -f /etc/init.d/"$1" ] && /etc/init.d/"$1" status >/dev/null 2>&1; }; fi; for svc in nginx apache2 httpd caddy haproxy lighttpd; do if _svc $svc; then echo "$svc: RUNNING"; $svc -v 2>&1 || $svc -V 2>&1 | head -1; fi; done; echo 'DONE'

databases.name: Databases
databases.command: if command -v systemctl >/dev/null 2>&1 && systemctl is-system-running 2>/dev/null | grep -qE 'running|degraded'; then _svc() { systemctl is-active "$1" >/dev/null 2>&1; }; elif command -v rc-service >/dev/null 2>&1; then _svc() { rc-service "$1" status >/dev/null 2>&1; }; else _svc() { [ -f /etc/init.d/"$1" ] && /etc/init.d/"$1" status >/dev/null 2>&1; }; fi; for svc in postgresql mysql mariadb mongod redis-server redis valkey memcached elasticsearch; do if _svc $svc; then echo "$svc: RUNNING"; fi; done; echo '---'; psql --version 2>/dev/null; mysql --version 2>/dev/null; mongod --version 2>/dev/null | head -1; redis-server --version 2>/dev/null; valkey-server --version 2>/dev/null; echo 'DONE'

login_users.name: Login Users
login_users.command: awk -F: '$3>=1000 && $7 != "/sbin/nologin" && $7 != "/usr/sbin/nologin" && $7 != "/bin/false" {printf "%s uid=%s shell=%s home=%s\n",$1,$3,$7,$6}' /etc/passwd; echo '---'; echo 'GROUPS:'; for user in $(awk -F: '$3>=1000 && $7 != "/sbin/nologin" && $7 != "/usr/sbin/nologin" && $7 != "/bin/false" {print $1}' /etc/passwd); do echo "$user: $(groups $user 2>/dev/null | cut -d: -f2)"; done

package_versions.name: Package Versions
package_versions.command: for pkg in nginx httpd apache2 postfix dovecot redis redis-server valkey postgresql postgresql-server mysql mariadb mariadb-server mongodb-server docker-ce podman haproxy caddy fail2ban openssh-server rsyslog opendkim certbot python3 node java php perl openssl curl wget git; do ver=$(rpm -q $pkg --queryformat '%{VERSION}-%{RELEASE}' 2>/dev/null) && echo "$pkg=$ver" && continue; ver=$(dpkg-query -W -f='${Version}' $pkg 2>/dev/null) && echo "$pkg=$ver" && continue; ver=$(apk info -v $pkg 2>/dev/null | head -1) && [ -n "$ver" ] && echo "$pkg=$ver" && continue; ver=$(pacman -Q $pkg 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $2}') && [ -n "$ver" ] && echo "$pkg=$ver"; done 2>/dev/null; echo 'DONE'
